title: Transit Hub: Orchestrated Workspace Switch & Sidebar Flow
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Redesign the console's left rail and top routing to create a single 'Transit Hub' surface that consolidates workspace switching, route awareness, and rollout/cost lenses. This ticket covers exploration, high-fidelity prototype, and initial usability validation for an orchestrated switch flow that preserves context (selected workspace, active route, pinned dashboards) while offering faster cross-workspace navigation.
background: Current console navigation disperses workspace switching across top-right menus and deep-surface quick links, which increases cognitive load and requires repeated context rehydration when switching workspaces. PM telemetry shows 18% of users open the workspace menu more than twice per session; support logs include several workflow interruptions where users lose dashboard state during switch. Design audit flagged inconsistent affordances across panes and low discoverability of rollouts/cost lenses.
goals: Provide a single discoverable Transit Hub that surfaces workspace switch, recent contexts, and per-route cost lenses
Reduce full-page reloads and lost dashboard state during workspace switch to <2% of switches
Make rollout and cost controls reachable within two taps from the hub
Deliver a prototype for internal validation and a design handoff ready for engineering in Q2
proposed_solutions: Left-rail compact hub icon that expands into a transient Transit Hub overlay (keyboard accessible)
Workspace switch preserves active route via route pinning and preserves dashboard query params using route-level session cache
Context cards inside hub: Recent Workspaces, Pinned Routes, Active Rollouts, Cost Alerts
Progressive disclosure: show high-level cost summary on hub, link into full cost dashboard in Console > Billing
decisions: Use overlay transient pattern instead of full-route navigation to keep users in context
Expose only three primary actions in the compact hub (Switch Workspace, Open Rollouts, View Cost Summary) to reduce choice paralysis
Defer multi-tenant role-aware filtering (showing only allowed workspaces) to Dedicated phase to reduce complexity for initial rollout
tradeoffs: Overlay preserves context but adds complexity for keyboard focus management; requires careful ARIA implementation
Keeping route-state on switch increases client-state complexity and raises edge cases when model/version pinned across workspaces
Showing cost summary in-hub may duplicate Console billing information; must balance noise with quick insights
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity Figma prototype reviewed and signed off by Product and Eng
Micro-usability test (n=6) with PM/SE personas shows 80% task success for switching while preserving dashboard filters
Design spec includes keyboard flow, ARIA requirements, animation timing, and edge-case notes for engineering handoff
Design handoff ticket created with named eng owners and a list of required backend flags
review_feedback: PM Maya Hernandez: prefer overlay be dismissible with Escape and clicking outside; ensure analytics events for hub open/close
Eng Arun Gupta: need an API contract for session-level route pins and clear fallback behavior when pinned model isn't available in destination workspace
Design review (Sofia): tighten vertical spacing in compact hub to fit 5 items on small screens; add microcopy explaining cost summary metric
Accessibility review (external consultant): ensure focus trapping is conditional and provide skip-to-target for screen readers
next_steps: Resolve engineering API open questions with Backend by 2025-02-21
Run 6 remote usability sessions (interviews + task funnel) in Cycle 47
Produce final design spec and copy deck for handoff (due 2025-02-28)
Create engineering tickets for keyboard/ARIA and session-cache integration
